title: TRICARE Select: One Enrollment per Beneficiary and Changes from Other TRICARE Plans
content:
**Rule.** A beneficiary may hold at most one **TRICARE Select** enrollment at a time (a limit of 1 per beneficiary). A beneficiary may not be enrolled in TRICARE Select and TRICARE Prime, or in TRICARE Select and a premium-based plan, at the same time; electing Select while holding an active Prime or premium-based plan enrollment is a plan change that ends the other enrollment on the day before the Select effective date and can only be made at open season or within a qualifying-life-event window. The beneficiary has no applied or active Select enrollment in the region on the application date.

## Condition for registering a new Select application

| Element | Reading |
|---|---|
| What is checked | the beneficiary's TRICARE Select enrollments in the region, as the enrollment records show them |
| Authority | the system record, never the caller's account |
| When it is checked | as of the application date, before the application is registered |
| Object | the beneficiary named on the application |
| Met when | no Select enrollment of that beneficiary stands applied or active on that date |

A Select enrollment of the same beneficiary that has ended (rejected, disenrolled, terminated or transferred out) does not stand in the way of a new application.

## Plan changes into Select

- The other plan (TRICARE Prime or a premium-based plan) ends on the day before the Select effective date. With a hypothetical Select effective date of 2026-01-01, the Prime enrollment ends on 2025-12-31.
- The change can only be made at open season or within a qualifying-life-event window; outside both, the plan change is not available.
